rows.interface: node 1 / 4 metal <-> REF (rotor vanes' rings on the sleeve, Ca node-1 plates, Z1 / Z4 top, D3 / D4, Coa1 / Co1)
node 2 / 3 metal <-> REF (Ca node-2 plates, D1 / D2, D4 / D3 ends)
node 1 <-> node 4 (only where side A meets side B)
a clamp string, end to end (= node 1 / 4 <-> REF)
one chain stage: its diode / capacitor (7.5 kV)
a ring's lead and the chain's top <-> REF (+-15 kV DC)
ring A's lead <-> ring B's lead (keep apart)

glazed alumina / steatite: does not track: creepage need not exceed the clearance (IEC 60664-1)

AH.where: on the z axis, top and bottom of the vessel

material_data.source: Fair-Rite's 77 material data sheet (https://www.fair-rite.com/77-material-data-sheet/), as a web search rendered it on 2026-10-09; not re-read here (the session's network policy blocks the host): verify against the current sheet before ordering
material_data.note: the register's rho 5 ohm m (presets/electromagnets-RA.json AH_rod) is five times the sheet's; at 120 Hz either leaves a skin depth of metres. B_sat at 100 C is the register's 0.38 T, not on the rendered sheet

coil.window: variant (a)'s window, 3.2 x 40 mm (its 50 turns of 1.6 mm wire), rewound with 160 turns
coil.wire: 0.80 mm grade-1 enamelled (0.869 mm over), orthocyclic, 4 layers of up to 46 turns, 3.13 mm build

AH.potential: the coil's cold end; the core tied to it (about the shaft's potential)
AH.end: the outer corner facing the seat rounded to r >= 1.5 mm at REF: a conductive-coated former flange tied to the core, or a REF end ring over the last turns

AH_seat.between: the vessel's pole and the core's tip
AH_seat.holds: 4.5 kV/mm in the PEEK settled at the AH end rounded to 1.5 mm; 2.3 kV/mm on average (sim/hub-beads-settled-findings.md §5)

hub_inputs.retainer: PEEK, unfilled (natural grade; no carbon or glass fill), machined from annealed stock
